title: Compatibility of normalized universal coefficient comparisons with transposition
statement: In the finite-field, l-invertible, finite-type setting of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], let S be a supplied coherent coefficient calculus [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], O the ordinary quotient projection and H its constant-ring factorization [def-pur-sequence-adjoint-resolution-data]. Fix any right pair RP, eta and comparison kappa satisfying the representative normalization of [lem-pur-sequence-kinjective-comparison-shifts]. There exists a normalized universal K-flat comparison A [lem-pur-sequence-kflat-comparison-shifts] such that for every base complex Q, system complex I and chain map f:O.pullback(Q) to I, the S-transpose of A.reductionCounit_Q followed by [f] equals the localized ordinary transpose of f, followed by the localized ordinary-limit comparison O.limit_I, followed by eta_I and kappa_[I]. Q and I need not themselves be resolving. This is compatibility of the two universal coefficient comparisons with the ordinary chain-map transpose, before any simultaneous replacement is chosen.

proof.text: Take the normalized universal K-flat comparison on the strict ordinary quotient pullback. On a flat-term K-flat representative its counit is the common strict-model comparison, including all quotient transitions.

theorem purSequenceComparisonTranspose
    (F : FiniteFieldDatum.{t}) (hl : l ≠ F.p)
    [W.Over (Spec (.of F.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (W ↘ Spec (.of F.k))] [QuasiCompact (W ↘ Spec (.of F.k))]
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W)
    (hS : CoefficientDerivedSystemCoherence l E W S)
    (O : PurSequenceOrdinaryAdjoints l E W)
    (H : PurSequenceRingedFactorization l E W O)
    (RP : coefficientSequenceDerived l E W ⥤
      DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E W))
    (η : (SequenceKInjectiveComparison.push l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Q ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ RP)
    (κ : RP ≅ coefficientSequenceLimit l E W)
    (hn : SequenceKInjectiveComparison.Normalization l E W RP η κ) :
    ∃ A : PurSequenceKFlatComparison l E W S O,
    ∀ (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ)
    (I : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ)
    (f : (O.pullback.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q ⟶ I),
    S.adjunction.homEquiv (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)
      (A.reductionCounit.app Q ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f) =
    DerivedCategory.Q.map ((O.adjunction.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).homEquiv Q I f) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex O.limit (.up ℤ)).hom.app I) ≫
      η.app I ≫ κ.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)
